comp-m7c9ubfk1.html: Accessibility Features on Our Site

comp-m7c9ubfm.html: We have made our website compliant with WCAG 2.1 guidelines, achieving an accessibility level of AA. Our content has been optimized for compatibility with assistive devices, ensuring that everyone can access our services. Key adjustments include:

comp-m7c9ubfo.html:
Utilized tools to identify and resolve potential accessibility challenges


    Defined the site’s language for better understanding


    Organized content structure for easy navigation


    Implemented descriptive alt text for all images


    Ensured color schemes provide necessary contrast


    Minimized motion and distractions throughout the site


    Made all multimedia content accessible
